```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble)
})

# ----- set these to match your columns -------------------------------------
sample_col  <- "sample"      # column identifying each metagenome sample
value_col   <- "rel_abund"   # abundance/coverage value to correlate
min_samples <- 5            # min co-occurring samples to test (>=3 required; 5+ advised)

# ----- 1. tidy long table (bin already = representative for plasmids) ------
dat <- comb_mp2 %>%
  transmute(feature = bin, origin,
            sample = .data[[sample_col]],
            value  = .data[[value_col]], taxa_gtdb) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(feature, origin, sample) %>%      # collapse multi-contig bins
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")

tax <- comb_mp2 %>%                            # one taxonomy per feature
  distinct(feature = bin, origin, taxa_gtdb) %>%
  group_by(feature, origin) %>% slice(1L) %>% ungroup()

# ----- 2. samples x feature matrices (absence = NA) ------------------------
to_mat <- function(df)
  df %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = sample, names_from = feature,
                     values_from = value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample") %>% as.matrix()

Pw <- to_mat(filter(dat, origin == "plasmid"))
Mw <- to_mat(filter(dat, origin == "mag"))
common <- intersect(rownames(Pw), rownames(Mw))
P <- Pw[common, , drop = FALSE]   # samples x plasmids
M <- Mw[common, , drop = FALSE]   # samples x mags

# ----- 3. pairwise-complete Pearson r for ALL pairs (only co-present samples)
presP <- !is.na(P); storage.mode(presP) <- "double"
presM <- !is.na(M); storage.mode(presM) <- "double"
Pz <- P; Pz[is.na(Pz)] <- 0
Mz <- M; Mz[is.na(Mz)] <- 0

n   <- crossprod(presP, presM)        # plasmids x mags : co-occurring samples
Sx  <- crossprod(Pz,       presM)
Sy  <- crossprod(presP,    Mz)
Sxx <- crossprod(Pz * Pz,  presM)
Syy <- crossprod(presP,    Mz * Mz)
Sxy <- crossprod(Pz,       Mz)

R <- (n * Sxy - Sx * Sy) /
  sqrt((n * Sxx - Sx^2) * (n * Syy - Sy^2))   # Pearson r, plasmids x mags

# ----- 4. long, filter to co-occurring pairs, p-value + FDR ----------------
res <- tibble(
  plasmid   = rep(rownames(R), times = ncol(R)),
  mag       = rep(colnames(R), each  = nrow(R)),
  pearson   = as.vector(R),
  n_samples = as.vector(n)
) %>%
  filter(n_samples >= min_samples, is.finite(pearson)) %>%
  mutate(
    t       = pearson * sqrt((n_samples - 2) / (1 - pearson^2)),
    p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(t), df = n_samples - 2),
    p_adj   = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")          # FDR correction
  ) %>%
  select(-t)

# ----- 5. attach taxonomy for plasmid and mag ------------------------------
res <- res %>%
  left_join(tax %>% filter(origin == "plasmid") %>%
              select(plasmid = feature, plasmid_taxa_gtdb = taxa_gtdb), by = "plasmid") %>%
  left_join(tax %>% filter(origin == "mag") %>%
              select(mag = feature, mag_taxa_gtdb = taxa_gtdb), by = "mag") %>%
  arrange(p_adj, desc(abs(pearson)))

res2 = res %>%
  filter(pearson >= 0.5)

# write_xlsx(
#   res2,
#   path = file.path(data_dir, "co_corr_all_arc_supplementary.xlsx")
# )


```



```{r}
orc_group = pc %>%
  #filter(orc_group == "Y") %>%
  filter(representative == member_id) %>% select(member_id, representative, translation_table) %>%
  filter(translation_table == "TT34")

sylph = sylph_mp
sylph2 = sylph %>%
  filter(rel_abund > 0)

library(readxl)
mfd_meta = read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "2025-05-28_mfd_db.xlsx")) %>%
  select(fieldsample_barcode, mfd_sampletype, mfd_hab1, mfd_hab2, mfd_hab3) %>%
  rename(sample = fieldsample_barcode) 


orc_group2 = orc_group %>%
  distinct(representative, .keep_all = T) %>% select(-member_id) %>%
  inner_join(sylph2, by = "representative") %>%
  left_join(mfd_meta, by = "sample") %>% select(-mfd_sampletype, mfd_hab1) %>%
  filter(translation_table == "TT34")

orc_group3 = orc_group2 %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abund = coalesce(as.numeric(rel_abund), 0),
    sample  = replace_na(sample, "NA_sample"),
    st_hab1 = replace_na(st_hab1, "NA_habitat")
  )
```

# heatmap for paper
```{r}
sylph_mags = sylph_mp
mags = fread(file.path(data_dir, "MFD_mags_V4.tsv")) %>%
  select(bin, MAG_status)
sylph_mags2 = sylph_mags %>%
  left_join(mags)

library(vegan)

# 
# pearson = fread(file.path(data_dir, "pairs_correlation_pearson.tsv"))
# pearson2 = pearson %>%
#   inner_join(test2 %>% distinct(representative, .keep_all = T) %>% rename(plasmid_rep = representative), by = "plasmid_rep") %>%
#   filter(r >= 0.7) %>%
#   distinct(mag_rep, .keep_all = T)

plot_mags = sylph_mags2 %>%
  #rename(mag_rep = plasmid_rep) %>%
  #inner_join(pearson2 %>% mutate(bin = sub(".*_", "", mag_rep)) %>% select(mag_rep, bin, r, n), by = "bin") %>% 
  filter(bin == "MFD01716.bin.1.47") %>%
  #rename(rep = mag_rep) %>% 
  mutate(origin = "mag") %>%
  select(sample, st_hab1, rel_abund, origin, taxa_gtdb, MAG_status, bin)


plot_plasmids = sylph_mags2 %>%
  inner_join(orc_group3 %>% distinct(representative), by = "representative") %>%
  select(-bin) %>% rename(bin = representative) %>% mutate(origin = "plasmid") %>%
  select(sample, st_hab1, rel_abund, origin, taxa_gtdb, MAG_status, bin)


combine = rbind(plot_mags, plot_plasmids) %>%
  left_join(mfd_meta, by = "sample") %>% select(-mfd_sampletype, mfd_hab1) 

t_combine = combine %>%
  select(-st_hab1, -mfd_hab1, -mfd_hab2, -mfd_hab3) %>%
  #left_join(pfd_md2 %>% filter(representative == member_id) %>% select(representative, taxa_gtdb), by = "representative")  %>%
  left_join(mfd_meta %>% mutate(st_hab1 = paste(mfd_sampletype, mfd_hab1, sep = ";")), by = "sample") %>%
  arrange(mfd_hab2) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = unique(sample))) %>%
  mutate(mfd_hab2 = factor(mfd_hab2, levels = unique(mfd_hab2))) %>%
  mutate(y = "MFD02") %>%
  mutate(bin = factor(bin, levels = unique(bin)))
#mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = level, ordered = TRUE))

## make sample x representative matrix
all_groups_wide = t_combine %>%
  select(sample, bin, rel_abund) %>%
  mutate(rel_abund = coalesce(as.numeric(rel_abund), 0)) %>%
  distinct(sample, bin, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = sample,
    names_from = bin,
    values_from = rel_abund,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

## remove samples with no abundance
all_groups_wide = all_groups_wide %>%
  filter(rowSums(select(., -sample)) > 0)

mat <- all_groups_wide[, -1]
rownames(mat) <- all_groups_wide$sample

## order x-axis: samples
sample_dist <- vegdist(decostand(mat, method = "hellinger"), method = "bray")
sample_clust <- hclust(sample_dist, method = "ward.D2")
#sample_level <- sample_clust$labels[order.dendrogram(as.dendrogram(sample_clust))]
sample_level <- all_groups_wide %>%
  left_join(
    t_combine %>%
      select(sample, st_hab1, mfd_hab2) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  arrange(st_hab1, mfd_hab2, desc(`MFD01716.bin.1.47`)) %>%
  pull(sample) %>%
  unique()

## order y-axis: representatives
rep_dist <- vegdist(decostand(t(mat), method = "hellinger"), method = "bray")
rep_clust <- hclust(rep_dist, method = "ward.D2")
rep_level <- rep_clust$labels[order.dendrogram(as.dendrogram(rep_clust))]

t_combine2 <- t_combine %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_level, ordered = TRUE),
    bin = factor(bin, levels = rep_level, ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample), !is.na(bin)) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>% mutate(n_sample = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_sample >= 5) #%>%
#distinct(bin) %>% filter(grepl("MFD", bin))


```




```{r, fig.width=8.2677, fig.height=6.6929, out.width="100%"}
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(svglite)

highlight_reps_plas = c(
  "contig_91650__MFD01716",
  "contig_33344__MFD04752",
  "contig_57306__MFD09567",
  "contig_90854__MFD01716",
  "contig_42799__MFD05580",
  "contig_51694__MFD09567",
  "contig_103805__MFD04752"
)

highlight_reps_mag = c("MFD01716.bin.1.47")

# Run after the chunk that creates t_combine2.
# Figure dimensions in cm; 21 cm is the full width of portrait A4.
figure_width <- 32
figure_height <- 23
label_angle <- 55

focal_reps <- c(highlight_reps_mag, highlight_reps_plas)
focal_tiles <- t_combine2 %>%
  filter(bin %in% focal_reps) %>%
  mutate(bin = factor(as.character(bin), levels = focal_reps))
main_tiles <- t_combine2 %>% filter(!bin %in% focal_reps)
sample_slots <- t_combine2 %>% distinct(sample, st_hab1)
habitats <- t_combine2 %>% distinct(sample, st_hab1, mfd_hab2)

mfd_hab2_cols = c(
  "NA"                                   = "black",
  "Sphagnum acid bogs"                   = "#4F86A0",
  "Temperate heath"                      = "#E79A95",
  "Standing freshwater"                  = "#63BCE5",
  "Semi-natural tall-herb humid meadows" = "#8FCB9B",
  "Sea dunes"                            = "#D8C3A5",
  "Temperate forests"                    = "#6A1FB0",
  "Calcareous fens"                      = "#A8D08D",
  "Fallow"                               = "#C49A6C",
  "Parks"                                = "#7FB069",
  "Poales, grass"                        = "#E6D63B",
  "Running freshwater"                   = "#3C91E6",
  "Forest (non-habitattype)"             = "#4E6E58",
  "Salt marshes and salt meadows"        = "#C9B037",
  "Influent"                             = "#F28E2B",
  "Potential pollution"                  = "#D95F02",
  "Biogas sludge"                        = "#C73A2B",
  "Groundwater"                          = "#1A178E",
  "High salinity (saltworks)"            = "#7A9E9F",
  "Activated sludge"                     = "#8C564B"
)

abundance_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#D9E7F5", "#9CC0DE", "#FCE0BC", "#F7A85B",
              "#E8602C", "#B81D13", "#6E0B0B", "#000000"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, .10, .25, .35, .50, .75, 1, 1.40, 2),
                           from = c(0, 2)),
  limits = c(0, 2), oob = scales::squish,
  breaks = c(0, .5, 1, 1.5, 2),
  labels = c("0.0", "0.5", "1.0", "1.5", "2.0"),
  name = "Relative\nabundance [%]"
)

# Identical facets and expansion keep all three rows aligned.
facet_samples <- facet_grid(. ~ st_hab1, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")
plot_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0, "mm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey35", linewidth = .3),
    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.clip = "off",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "mm")
  )

heatmap <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(sample, bin, fill = rel_abund)) +
    geom_blank(data = sample_slots, aes(x = sample), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_tile(colour = "grey25", linewidth = .18) +
    facet_samples +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = .5)) +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right", expand = expansion(add = .5)) +
    abundance_scale + plot_theme
}

# Anchor each slanted heading at the centre of its own facet.
heading_labels <- sample_slots %>%
  group_by(st_hab1) %>% summarise(midpoint = (n() + 1) / 2, .groups = "drop")
p_headings <- ggplot(sample_slots, aes(x = sample)) +
  geom_blank() + facet_samples +
  geom_text(data = heading_labels,
            aes(x = midpoint, y = 0, label = st_hab1),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = label_angle, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
            size = 10 / .pt) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = .5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + plot_theme +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm"))

p_focal <- heatmap(focal_tiles) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(l = 2)),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm")
  )

# Keep this guide on the main heatmap: it is centred on the main tiles.
origin_colours <- c(plasmid = "#000000", mag = "#B3B3B3")

p_main <- heatmap(main_tiles) +
  # An invisible point layer supplies a compact key for the left-hand strips.
  geom_point(aes(colour = origin), alpha = 0, size = 0, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = origin_colours, name = "Sequence type",
                      limits = c("plasmid", "mag"), breaks = c("plasmid", "mag"), labels = c("Plasmid", "MAG")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(
    title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0,
    barheight = grid::unit(40, "mm"), barwidth = grid::unit(3, "mm"), order = 1
  ), colour = guide_legend(order = 2,
                           keyheight = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
                           override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3, shape = 15))) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", legend.justification = c(0, .5),
    legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left",
    legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(6, "mm"),
    legend.key.spacing.y = grid::unit(0, "mm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# No y expansion or margins: the thin habitat band touches the main tiles.
p_habitat <- ggplot(habitats, aes(sample, 1, fill = mfd_hab2)) +
  geom_tile(height = 1) + facet_samples +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = .5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mfd_hab2_cols, name = "MFD02") +
  plot_theme +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "left")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(4, "mm")
  )

origin_strip <- function(data) {
  ggplot(distinct(data, bin, origin), aes(1, bin, fill = origin)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "grey25", linewidth = .18) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = origin_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = .5)) +
    theme_void() + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

# Patchwork keeps panel edges aligned; guides stay with their own plots.
xx <- wrap_plots(
  F = p_headings,
  A = origin_strip(focal_tiles) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm")),
  B = p_focal,
  C = origin_strip(main_tiles),
  # Let the abundance legend use the space underneath the focal row labels.
  D = free(p_main, type = "space", side = "r"), E = p_habitat,
  design = "#F\nAB\nCD\n#E",
  widths = grid::unit(c(2, 1), c("mm", "null")),
  heights = grid::unit(c(48, 18, 1, 5), c("mm", "mm", "null", "mm")),
  guides = "keep"
)

xx

ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "si_f10.png"), xx, width = figure_width, height = figure_height,
```
